faqs.question: How do I get from Coimbatore Airport to Karunya Institute?
faqs.answer: Coimbatore Airport is 25km from Karunya Institute. Options: 1) Auto-rickshaw (₹400-500, 45-60 mins), 2) Uber/Ola (₹300-400), 3) Pre-booked airport shuttle (contact hostel office). Airport bus is NOT recommended as it doesn't go directly to campus.

faqs.question: What is the WiFi password for the hostel?
faqs.answer: Hostel WiFi: Network: Karunya-WiFi-Guest, Password: KarunyaWifi2025. For high-speed campus WiFi, register at the IT office (room open 9 AM - 5 PM) with your hostel ID.

faqs.question: How do I access the mess (dining hall) in the hostel?
faqs.answer: Mess timings: Breakfast 7-8 AM, Lunch 12-1 PM, Dinner 7-8 PM. Hostel fee includes 3 meals daily. Vegetarian and non-vegetarian options available. Special dietary requests: contact hostel warden.

faqs.question: What are the emergency contacts at Karunya?
faqs.answer: Campus Security: +914224680000 ext 5555 (24/7). Karunya Medical Centre: +914224680444. For police/ambulance: 100/108. Student Affairs: +914224680000 ext 2000. Always inform your hostel warden in case of emergencies.

faqs.question: Where can I buy groceries and daily essentials?
faqs.answer: On campus: Organised Super Market (hostel area) open 8 AM - 8 PM. In city (RS Puram): Local supermarkets and traditional bazaars. Medical items: Health Centre on campus. Pharmacy: Campus pharmacy open 24/7 for emergency medicines.

faqs.question: How can I travel to nearby cities like Ooty or Munnar?
faqs.answer: Ooty (90km): Bus from Coimbatore (₹150-200, 3 hours). Munnar (110km): Bus from Coimbatore (₹200-300, 4 hours). Both available daily. Travel agencies near campus can arrange packages. Best seasons: Oct-Feb. Pack light jacket for hill stations.

faqs.question: What are the best places to eat near the campus?
faqs.answer: On campus: Hostel mess (3 meals included). Near campus: Ula Cafe (multicuisine), A2B (South Indian), Saravana Bhavan (vegetarian), street food at campus gates. In RS Puram: Govind Square has restaurants. Budget: ₹100-300 per meal outside campus.

faqs.question: How do I transport luggage to/from the airport?
faqs.answer: Option 1: Use Uber/Ola Auto (can fit 2-3 bags). Option 2: Book a pre-arranged auto from hostel (contact hostel office). Option 3: Luggage forwarding services available (ask hostel warden). Keep luggage tags with contact details.

faqs.question: What is the weather like in Coimbatore?
faqs.answer: Coimbatore weather: Generally pleasant year-round (20-32°C). Summer (Mar-May): Hot, 28-32°C. Monsoon (Jul-Sep): Rainy, 20-28°C, bring umbrella. Winter (Oct-Feb): Best season, 20-26°C. Pack: Light clothes, one light jacket, umbrella for monsoon.

faqs.question: How do I get local SIM card and mobile recharge?
faqs.answer: SIM cards: Available at airport or shops in Coimbatore city (bring passport & hostel ID). Major providers: Airtel, Jio, Vodafone. Recharge: Authorized shops around campus, online (using passport as ID). Top-up packs: ₹200-500 for calling/data. Emergency calls to India free.

faqs.question: What are the hostel rules and curfew timings?
faqs.answer: Hostel curfew: 10:30 PM daily (weekend 11 PM). Gate opens 6 AM. Late passes available from warden (notify 24 hrs in advance). Visitors allowed 6 AM - 7 PM (common areas only). Room cleanliness: Daily by attendant. Quiet hours: 10 PM onwards.

faqs.question: How can I meet my department coordinator or faculty?
faqs.answer: Department offices: Open 9 AM - 5 PM, Mon-Fri. Faculty office hours: Posted on department boards. For urgent matters: Contact department HOD's office. Academic advisor assigned: Check name at hostel/department office. Office hours also posted on department website (www.karunya.edu.in).

faqs.question: What recreational facilities are available in the hostel?
faqs.answer: Hostel facilities: Gym, sports court (badminton/volleyball), common room with TV, table tennis room, reading room. Sports clubs on campus: Cricket, football, basketball, martial arts. All students can join. Membership: Free or ₹500/semester depending on activity.

faqs.question: How do I report a maintenance issue in my hostel room?
faqs.answer: Maintenance request: Inform hostel warden or submit form at hostel office. Response time: 24-48 hours for urgent, 1 week for routine. For electrical/water emergencies: Contact campus security (+914224680000 ext 5555) immediately. Do NOT try to fix electrical issues yourself.

faqs.question: What banks are available near the campus?
faqs.answer: On campus: SBI ATM, cooperative bank near hostel. In Coimbatore city (15km): ICICI, HDFC, Axis, SBI branches. ATMs: Available every 500m in city. Opening hours: 10 AM - 4 PM (weekdays). Online banking recommended for convenience. Currency: INR only accepted.

faqs.question: Can I visit Ooty or nearby hill stations on weekends?
faqs.answer: Yes! Weekends (Fri-Sun) you can visit nearby attractions. Ooty (90km, 3 hrs): Botanical Garden, Coonoor (tea gardens). Munnar (110km, 4 hrs): Tea plantations, scenic views. Avanashi Temple (30km, 1 hr): Pilgrimage site. Book return tickets in advance. Inform hostel warden before overnight travel.

faqs.question: What should I bring to Coimbatore for the internship?
faqs.answer: Essential: Passport, visa, admission letter, hostel ID proof. Clothing: Light clothes, one formal outfit, jacket (hill visits). Electronics: Phone charger, adapter (230V Type D/M). Documents: Bank account details (for stipend), emergency contact list. Weather: Umbrella for monsoon. Medical: Prescription medicines, basic first aid kit.

faqs.question: How do I contact the international student office?
faqs.answer: International Student Office: Main Admin Building, Room 201. Hours: 9 AM - 5 PM, Mon-Fri. Phone: +914224680000 ext 2500. Email: international@karunya.edu.in. They handle visa extensions, documentation, and any immigration-related queries. Visit in person or call for urgent issues.

faqs.question: What is the cost of living in Coimbatore for an intern?
faqs.answer: Monthly expenses (excluding hostel): Meals (if not in mess) ₹3,000-5,000. Local transport ₹500-1,000. Entertainment/shopping ₹2,000-3,000. Total budget ₹5,500-9,000/month. Hostel included in package. ATMs & shops readily available. No expensive tourist traps near campus unlike hill stations.

faqs.question: Are there medical facilities available on campus?
faqs.answer: Yes! Karunya Medical Centre on campus: Open 8 AM - 6 PM daily (24/7 for emergencies). Basic treatments, first aid, medicines available. For serious cases: Referred to Ganga Hospital (15km) or Apollo (Coimbatore). Medical consultation: Free for students. Medicines: Nominal cost. Insurance: Check your enrollment details.
